# Prestige Pools of Wilmington

> Family-owned pool builder at Monkey Junction in Wilmington, North Carolina, since 1999. Prestige only installs Latham fiberglass pools (Latham Grand Dealer) and Pentair pool equipment, set by its own crews with its own machines. Founder Shane Kosnik has built pools since 1991. 5307 S College Rd, Wilmington, NC 28412. Phone 910-509-2370, Monday to Friday 8 am to 5 pm and Saturday 10 am to 2 pm, Eastern Time.

## Pools

- [Why fiberglass](https://www.prestigepoolsofwilmington.com/#fiberglass): a Latham pool is built at the factory as a single shell; installed in 3 to 5 days, against 4 to 8 weeks for concrete; smooth, non-porous surface that needs fewer chemicals and resists algae; lifetime warranty on the structure and 20 years on the surface.
- [How a pool goes in](https://www.prestigepoolsofwilmington.com/#build): layout, dig, shape, set, fill, wire (under Shane's pool electrical license), deck, swim. Prestige owns its dump trucks, excavators, track loaders and trailers; its crews have been with the company for more than 12 years.
- [Pool gallery](https://www.prestigepoolsofwilmington.com/#work): 34 pools built by Prestige around Wilmington: rectangles and freeforms, pools with spas, pools by the water, pools at night.
- [Cocktail pool](https://www.prestigepoolsofwilmington.com/#options): a 10 × 16 ft Latham pool for small yards, with full-width steps and benches all around; ready for an automatic cover and can be heated like a hot tub.

## Options

- [In the water](https://www.prestigepoolsofwilmington.com/#options): tanning ledges, spillover and stand-alone spas, Crystal Fountains deck jets, cascades, RicoRock waterfalls and jump boulders, S.R. Smith slides, vanishing edges, waterline tile and mosaics, CoverStar automatic covers, Latham gel coat colors.
- [Around the water](https://www.prestigepoolsofwilmington.com/#options): stamped concrete, seashell finish, coping, stamped stone, travertine, pavers, pool barrier compliant fences and gates, landscaping and stormwater drainage.
- [Out back](https://www.prestigepoolsofwilmington.com/#options): fire pits, fireplaces, outdoor kitchens, pergolas, gazebos, outdoor showers, pool enclosures.
- [Lighting](https://www.prestigepoolsofwilmington.com/#after-dark): Pentair LED pool lights (5 colors or 7 color-changing shows), controlled with Pentair automation; uplit palms and paths, string lights, fire bowls and fireplaces.

## Spas and equipment

- [Spas and hot tubs](https://www.prestigepoolsofwilmington.com/#spas): Latham spas built in with the pool (elevated spillover spas or stand-alone spas); Nordic Hot Tubs, made in America, for 2 to 8 people; Marquis hot tubs.
- [Pentair equipment](https://www.prestigepoolsofwilmington.com/#spas): certified Pentair provider: variable-speed pumps, filters, IntelliChlor salt chlorine generators, heaters and heat pumps, robotic cleaners, LED lights, IntelliCenter automation with the Pentair Home app.

## Company

- [Shane and the family](https://www.prestigepoolsofwilmington.com/#family): Shane and Darlene Kosnik own the company, on 2 acres at Monkey Junction. Licenses and certifications: North Carolina General Contractor license, SP-SP Electrical Contractor license for swimming pool construction, National Swimming Pool Foundation Certified Pool Operator, Certified Solar PV Installer, Leaktronics certified leak detection. Member of the Better Business Bureau and the Wilmington Chamber of Commerce. WECT Best of the Cape Fear, 2024 winner; Best of Houzz 2016 for service.
- [Reviews](https://www.prestigepoolsofwilmington.com/#reviews): customer reviews on Google and Facebook; many mention project manager Jordan Whitaker.
- [Financing](https://www.prestigepoolsofwilmington.com/#financing): Lyon Financial, HFS Financial, LightStream, Upgrade, AMS Financial, and USAlliance through LoanStar; loans are subject to credit approval.
- [Service and leak detection](https://www.prestigepoolsofwilmington.com/#service): service for pools Prestige installed; certified Leaktronics leak detection.
